text: Chapter 11: Off to Toram@The Weredragons & the Underground World
■Next Mission\nMove from Vulcani Crater Base to\nVulcani Underground Passage to start.
Join forces with the weredragons and head to Milcaska Falls\nlocated in the same direction as the weredragons' town\nin order to plan a strategy to defeat Coenubias!
While fighting Coenubia monsters, make your way to the\nweredragons' Army Base located beyond Milcaska Falls!
Restore the weredragons whom are being controlled by\nCoenubia by removing the crystals on the back of their neck!
A loud noise can be heard from the gate of the weredragons'\ntown. Coenubia's boss seems to be doing something.\nLet's hurry to check it out!
Gordel, the Coenubia's boss who attacked the Army Base is\nattacking the Weredragon's Mouth which is the entrance to\nthe town. Defeat it to protect the town!
[[N]]Free the weredragons that are being controlled
